bigger.line: The world just keeps gettin' bigger
stanza: So what becomes of all the little boys
Who run away from home?
The world just keeps gettin' bigger
Once you get out on your own

bigger.line: But I started to get bigger
stanza: First we fought for my mother
That afforded little joy
When he left she was heart broken
And I was still their little boy
But I started to get bigger
And to win the ugly game
When I made a little money
And I got a bit of fame

bigger.line: Didn't even know that love was bigger
stanza: Didn't even know that love was bigger
Didn't even know that love was so, so, hey hey hey
Bone digger, bone digger
Dogs in the moonlight
Far away in my well-lit door
Mr. Beer Belly, Beer Belly
Get these mutts away from me, you know
I don't find this stuff amusing anymore

trigger.line: No one doubted that he pulled the trigger
stanza: And to the black folks he was just a crazy nigga
No one doubted that he pulled the trigger
And though they could not produce the gun
The D.A. said he was the one who did the deed
And the all-white jury agreed
The devil's right hand
The devil's right hand
Nothin' touched the trigger
But the devil's right hand
My Mama said, "The pistol is the devil's right hand"
